description: This Java source file defines the ConceptsLockedException class, which extends APIException. It is thrown when attempts are made to manipulate concept data when concepts are globally locked in the OpenMRS system. The class provides multiple constructors to generate exceptions with default or custom messages, and with chained causes.

classes.name: ConceptsLockedException
classes.description: An exception thrown when concepts are locked and editing is attempted, providing multiple constructors for different use cases.

methods.name: ConceptsLockedException()
methods.description: Default constructor with a standard message indicating concepts are locked.

methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message when concepts are locked.

methods.name: ConceptsLockedException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor with custom message and underlying cause for chaining exceptions.

methods.name: ConceptsLockedException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor with only a cause for chaining exceptions.
